title: Custom domain apricity.anth.us: Amplify domain association, Route 53, TLS
description: Associate apricity.anth.us with the Amplify app: ACM certificate validation records and the alias to the CloudFront distribution, in Route 53 (zone from the USER task). Verify with dig and curl -I https://apricity.anth.us (200, valid cert, and the COOP/COEP/CORP headers the wasm app needs, set through Amplify custom headers). Record the exact DNS records in design/storage.md so it is reproducible. Depends on the Amplify Hosting app task.
